summary: Every change in the web app is checked against the signed sign-in of the person who made it; Access and History are in both editions.

new.title: Signed changes
new.text: The engine checks the signed sign-in of the person behind every web app change before it acts. SecurityInsight first only observes; once a SuperAdmin adopts the configuration on Configuration > Signed requests, an unverified change is held and explained.

new.title: Access and History in both editions
new.text: Configuration > Access (roles and scopes for people and groups) and Configuration > History (the audit trail) are part of the Community edition too. Every security control is the same in both editions.

new.title: Narrower database rights, step by step
new.text: Support can narrow each component's database rights to exactly its job, through the nightly update: first a plan that changes nothing, then the change, read back, and a way back.
